title: Radar Target
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Radar_Target.md
text: Radar target, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Fluctuation model} sets Fluctuation model; {Source of mean radar cross section}, {Mean radar cross section (m^2)}, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the operating frequency 3e8 and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Incident signal complex-valued N -by- 1 column vector | complex-valued N -by- M matrix

ports.name: RCS
ports.summary: Mean radar cross-section nonnegative scalar | 1-by- M row vector of nonnegative values

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Reflected signal complex-valued N -by- 1 column vector | complex-valued N -by- M matrix

params.name: Source of mean radar cross section
params.values: Source of mean radar cross section Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Fluctuation model
params.values: Fluctuation model Nonfluctuating (default) | Swerling1 | Swerling2 | Swerling3 | Swerling4

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
